about: Safe Mode (docs/adr/0054-recovery-and-erasing.mdx, decision 10), the session started in it (the development compositor's --safe-mode, as oxyos-session reads oxyos.safe-mode=1 on the kernel's command line), in English at scale 1, over a real oxyos-installd with the installed Chat probe (sample/BackgroundProbe.tsx, which declares a login item and background activity) kept in the dock and a preferences file whose applications opened at login are Inbox. The menu bar shows Safe Mode in red, which the screen reader's tree names, for the whole session; the session opens nothing at login (Settings' window is the only one), yet Settings' Login Items & Extensions still lists Inbox: the list is the person's, for the next normal start. Chat, opened from the dock, is told its background activity is not permitted (only the system's own applications run in the background in Safe Mode): its registration is refused, nothing is asked of the install service and nobody is told; Super+W closes its window and it ends as any application does, nothing left in the background. The preferences file is unchanged.
